page_title: FRE 1-3 AUG | Freiburg v Augsburg 23/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' That's it for today, Felix Zwayer has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+10' Augsburg exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
90+8' Augsburg work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+6' Cyriaque Irie (Freiburg) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
90+5' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Felix Zwayer had an easy-decision to make.
90+3' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) picks up an injury.
90+2' A spell of possession for Augsburg in an attempt to control the game.
90' 11 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Freiburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
89' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Freiburg comes to nothing.
87' Here's the change. Robin Fellhauer leaves the pitch and Arne Maier (Augsburg) comes on as a substitute.
87' Corner kicks – 3:4.
86' The referee allows time for a substitution. Marius Wolf will be replaced by Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg).
86' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
84' Mert Komur (Augsburg) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
84' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Augsburg.
81' Julian Schuster has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) replacing Christian Gunter.
81' The substitution has been made. Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) has replaced Johan Manzambi.
79' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall.
78' The attendance is 33600.
77' The resulting set piece from Augsburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
75' Cyriaque Irie (Freiburg) drives in a shot at goal, but the attempt from the edge of the box flashes just over the bar.
73' Total attempts – 13:9.
70' Here is a change. Elias Saad is going off and Sandro Wagner gives the last tactical orders to Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg).
70' Substitution. Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) replaces Yuito Suzuki.
70' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
68' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Felix Zwayer had an easy-decision to make.
68' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Finn Dahmen.
67' 58:42 – the ratio of ball possession.
65' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
62' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
61' Mert Komur (Augsburg) has tested the patience of referee Felix Zwayer and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
60' Phillip Tietz comes onto the pitch because Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
60' Julian Schuster has decided to make a change. Cyriaque Irie (Freiburg) replaces Eren Dinkci.
60' Looks like Finn Dahmen (Augsburg) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
58' 1 - 3 GOAL! Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) sends the penalty high into the top right hand corner of the net.
58' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is going to take the penalty!
58' The Freiburg players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

57' Play continues despite the shouts by some Freiburg players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Felix Zwayer interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
56' Surely that's handball by one of the Augsburg players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
53' The game is interrupted. Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
51' The linesman makes the right call and Freiburg will have a corner.
50' Felix Zwayer shows a yellow card to Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg) for his blatant foul.
49' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg). Good work from Freiburg as they win a corner.
48' Augsburg are seeing far more of the ball now.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+8' The match has reached half-time.
45+6' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Felix Zwayer had an easy-decision to make.
45+5' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 6:9.

45+2' 0 - 3 GOAL! Marius Wolf (Augsburg) receives the ball after a swift counter attack. Still with some work to do, he weaves his way through the defence to score a wonderful goal from close range to make it 0:3.
45+2' Freiburg win a corner.
45+1' Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Freiburg have been awarded a corner kick.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
42' 0 - 2 Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the bottom right corner. The score is 0:2.
42' Augsburg force a corner. They send men into the box.
40' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
39' The current number of corner kicks is 1:1.
37' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) was quite harsh and Felix Zwayer didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
36' A lofted cross from Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
34' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) attempts to score from a difficult angle on the edge of the box, but sends his effort narrowly wide of the left post.
32' 0 - 1 Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Noah Atubolu. 0:1.
28' A player from Augsburg brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
26' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 5:1.
24' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
22' Freiburg hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
18' The Freiburg players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
17' The Freiburg players halt their celebrations as referee Felix Zwayer makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
17' What a goal that is! Lucas Holer (Freiburg) gets to the ball inside the box and brilliantly lifts the ball over Finn Dahmen and into the net. 1:0.
16' The corner is swung in but Freiburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
14' The ball goes out of play. Augsburg are awarded a corner kick.
10' The percentage of ball possession is – 61:39.
6' Freiburg hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Freiburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

Augsburg will kick the game off.
